fp8_fast seems to cause huge quality degradation

fp_16_fast enables "Full FP16 Accmumulation in FP16 GEMMs" feature available in the very latest pytorch nightly, this is around 20% speed boost. 

Sageattn if you have it installed can be used for almost double inference speed

Adjust the blocks to swap based on your VRAM, this is a tradeoff between speed and memory usage.

Alternatively there's option to use VRAM management introduced in DiffSynt-Studios. This is usually slower, but saves even more VRAM compared to BlockSwap

Further VRAM savings are from torch.compile or alternatively using the chunked rope option in the WanVideoSampler -node

Prompt Writing Tip: If you do not wish to alter the subject's facial features, simply use "a man" or "a woman" without adding extra descriptions of their appearance. Prompts support both Chinese and English input. The prompt is intended for generating frontal, medium-to-close-up videos.

Input Image Recommendation: For best results, use a high-resolution frontal face image. There are no restrictions on resolution or file extension, as our built-in preprocessing pipeline will handle them automatically.
